constraints.ocl:
context Address
inv: (self.customer <> null) and (self.line1 <> null)

context CardTransaction
inv: (self.card.isActive) and (self.merchant <> '' and self.merchant.size() > 0)

context Account
inv: self.transactions->any(x | x.amount >= 10) <> null

context Loan
inv: if self.interestRate < self.principal then self.interestRate else self.principal endif >= 12

context Loan
inv: self.interestRate <> null and self.principal <> null

context Address
inv: self.line1 <> null implies self.city <> null

context Address
inv: self.country <> null implies self.line1 <> null

context Bank
inv: self.branches->any(x | x.city <> '') <> null

context Employee
inv: (self.branch <> null) and (not(self.branch <> null))

context Loan
inv: (self.interestRate <> self.principal) and (not(self.interestRate <> self.principal))

context Teller
inv: (self.counterNo mod 5 = 0) and (not(self.counterNo mod 5 = 0))

context Customer
inv: (self.accounts->collect(x | x.transactions)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.accounts->collect(x | x.transactions)->size() >= 1))

context Branch
inv: (self.employees->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null) and (not(self.employees->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null))

context Teller
inv: (self.counterNo mod 2 = 1) and (not(self.counterNo mod 2 = 1))

context Account
inv: ((self.balance <= 1000) and (self.transactions->forAll(v | v.amount < 100))) and (not((self.balance <= 1000) and (self.transactions->forAll(v | v.amount < 100))))

context Branch
inv: (self.customers->exists(x | x.email <> '')) and (not(self.customers->exists(x | x.email <> '')))

context Address
inv: ((self.customer <> null) and (self.postalCode <> null)) and (not((self.customer <> null) and (self.postalCode <> null)))

context Loan
inv: (self.principal >= 41 and self.principal <= 63) and (self.principal < 41)

context Address
inv: (self.line1 <> null and self.city <> null) and (not(self.line1 <> null and self.city <> null))

context Customer
inv: ((self.email <> '') and (self.loans->forAll(v | v.interestRate <= 10))) and (not((self.email <> '') and (self.loans->forAll(v | v.interestRate <= 10))))

context Customer
inv: (self.kyc <> null) and (not(self.kyc <> null))

context Customer
inv: (self.address <> null) and (not(self.address <> null))
